reflections.title: "Glorified in You"

reflect.text: Our greatest purpose in life is to honor the name and character of the Lord Jesus. The Holy Spirit is always working to lift up Jesus, and He welcomes us to join Him in this work. When our supreme aim is to make Christ look great, it gives meaning to everything we face, whether we speak or keep silent, act or suffer.

Living to honor Jesus can feel like too high an aim for us. Yet the Lord does not leave us to try in our own strength. As F. B. Meyer wrote, God "first instills the desire, and then realizes it". God places the longing for goodness into our hearts, and then He provides the power to bring that good desire to life.

Because God provides the power for every good work of faith, He receives all the glory for what is done. Daily Christian life is good news because God answers prayer by giving fresh grace, His kindness and help that we do not earn. Relying on Him keeps us humble and full of joy while honoring Him as supreme.

questions: What good desire has God placed in your heart that you need His power to carry out today?
How does knowing that God supplies all the strength help you stay both humble and joyful?
reflections.prayer: Lord Jesus, we want our lives to bring honor to Your name in all we do. Thank You for giving us good desires and for providing the strength to fulfill them. Teach us to depend daily on Your grace so that You receive all the glory. Amen.
